title: Operations Manager, Operative Acquisition
description:
Relay is fundamentally reshaping how goods move in an online era. Backed by Europe’s largest-ever logistics Series A ($35M) led by deep-tech investors Plural, and a recently closed Series B ($95M), Relay is scaling faster than 99% of venture-backed startups. We're assembling the most talent-dense team the logistics industry has ever seen

Relay’s Mission is to free commerce from friction. Today, high delivery costs act as a hidden tax on e-commerce, quietly shaping what can be sold online and limiting who can participate. We envision a world where more goods move more freely between more people, making the online shopping experience seamless and accessible to everyone.

THE TEAM
• ~160 people, around half in engineering, product and data
• 45+ advanced degrees across computer science, mathematics and operations research
• Thousands of data points captured, calculated, analysed and predicted for every single parcel we handle
• An intellectually vibrant culture of first‑principles thinking, tight feedback loops and relentless experimentation

THE ROLE

Every parcel through our sort centres is handled by an operative. At peak, we need to hire up to 600 of them a week.

As Operations Manager, Operative Acquisition you'll own operative supply across our sortation sites: enough suitable, trained, compliant and active operatives to fill every shift. You'll build the funnel, reporting and automation that make supply repeatable rather than manual, and keep it ahead of demand as volume rises.

Volumes rise sharply into November and December. Supply, not demand, will be the constraint. This role exists to make sure it isn't.

You'll be the single owner of the operative funnel, working across acquisition (including paid channels), Live Operations, our site teams, and Product and Engineering, who build the integrations the funnel runs on. You'll write SQL, ship automation, and spend time at our sort centres seeing how new starters actually land.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own the operative funnel end to end, from applicant attraction through qualification, training, activation and retention

- Keep applicant supply ahead of site demand, forecasting how many applicants, training places and sessions are needed and directing spend where gaps exist

- Improve qualification and compliance, owning Right to Work/KYC and working with Product and Engineering to reduce drop-off and speed up the process

- Optimise training capacity and waitlists, making sure sessions are filled and candidates stay engaged

- Get new starters onto shift quickly, supporting activation, shift fill, communications and low-fill processes

- Reduce cancellations, no-shows and inactivity, using the root causes to improve communications, processes and policies

- Own operative communications and compliance processes, including waitlist messaging, suspensions, strikes and shift-booking comms

- Build clear funnel reporting and alerts, tracking volumes, conversion, time to hire and drop-off by site to identify issues early

WHO WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE?

- A growth or operations background. You treat supply as a daily number and act the same day it slips

- Confident in SQL (BigQuery or similar). You build dashboards from raw data, not static trackers

- Experience running a high-volume hiring or onboarding funnel, ideally for a frontline workforce

- Comfortable with paid acquisition, Google Ads or similar, enough to read performance and brief changes when a site runs short

- Hands-on with automation, setting up triggers for invitations, comms and alerts, and quick to get confident in a new ATS or scheduling system

- A working understanding of Right to Work checks, enough to see how checks and re-checks affect the funnel and operative status. Legal owns the detail, but this can't be a blank

- Clear writing. You can write processes, requirements and comms that other teams rely on

Desirable

- Experience onboarding couriers or drivers at a carrier or delivery platform

- Experienc

title: ICT Infrastructure Architect
description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!

HOW WE OPERATE

- Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

- Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

HOW WE OPERATE

- Extreme ownership. Full autonomy. Own things end to end often taking on scope outside your core role without being asked to get things done.

- Velocity. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

- First principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

THE INFRASTRUCTURE TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

- Design the physical layer AGI is trained on. ISP/OSP cable plants carry hundreds of thousands of fiber terminations per building, rail-optimized for the densest GPU fabrics ever built, at 800G today and 1.6T next.

- One design, every site. Turn the cable plant from a bespoke months-long exercise into a stamped reference architecture deployed across 10s to 100s of GWs of capacity, validated once and built everywhere.

- Design for silicon that doesn't exist yet. Every GPU generation rewrites the density, optics, and pathway math, but the plant you spec must survive three of them.

ROLE SCOPE

- Own the end-to-end physical implementation of the data center network: fiber plant architecture, transceiver planning, and structured cabling integration for hyperscale sites.

- Collaborate with CSA, MEP, and construction teams on power, cooling, space, pathways, cabinets, and racks, and develop, read, and interpret construction drawings in Bluebeam, ACC, and Procore.

- Break down DCN logical port maps (TOR, spine, super-spine, DCI) into physical cross-connect and patching schedules, and automate port-to-fiber mapping at 100K+ ports per site.

- Define cassette types (MTP/MPO Base-8/12/16), trunk counts, and structured cabling hierarchy, and model fiber utilization and overbuild for two to three hardware generations.

- Select optics (400G/800G DR4, FR4, LR4, SR8, coherent DCI) by reach and loss budget, validate interoperability across vendors and generations, and maintain loss-budget and margin models for every link type.

- Own the ICT Basis of Design, SOPs, and Division 26/27/28/33 master specifications, and integrate with DCIM (NetBox, custom tools) to track strands, ports, and patching.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

1. AI Practice & Solution Architecture (40%)

• Lead AI strategy, architecture, and solution design across GenAI, ML, data platforms, and MLOps/AIOps

• Produce key technical artefacts yourself with architecture blueprints, data pipeline designs, solution specs not just review or delegate

• Experience directing offshore teams across time zones to briefing engineers, reviewing outputs, giving structured feedback

title: Hardware Field Quality Engineer Intern (Summer 2027)
description:
At Lyft, our purpose is to serve and connect. Lyft Urban Solutions designs, builds, and operates bikeshare systems in more than 50 cities worldwide, including New York, Chicago, London, Barcelona, Mexico City, Rio de Janeiro, and Montréal. Our Longueuil facility is the birthplace of BIXI, North America's first automated bikeshare system, and today builds the bikes and stations behind some of the world's largest bikeshare networks.

We are looking for a Hardware Field Quality Engineer Intern to join our Field Quality team at our Longueuil facility. Once our bikes, e-bikes, batteries, and stations leave the factory, Field Quality owns how they hold up in the real world: millions of rides, all four seasons, in cities across the globe. You will work alongside field quality engineers to help spot emerging hardware issues, investigate their root cause, and support fixes with engineering, manufacturing, and market operations teams. You will spend time hands-on with failed parts in the lab, and just as much time in the data working out how big a problem really is.

Responsibilities:

• Support failure analysis on parts returned from the field, including requests from enterprise customers, by helping with teardown, inspection, and electrical testing and documenting findings with photos.

• Help monitor field data, such as vehicle and station alerts and repair records, and flag emerging issues to the team.

• Build and update dashboards and queries that track reliability metrics and retrofit progress.

• Assist with field retrofit campaigns by helping identify affected units and tracking progress.

• Help review repair SOPs and troubleshooting guides used by market mechanics, and suggest improvements.

• Contribute to field failure investigations in Jira, working with engineers on root cause and corrective actions.

Experience:

• Currently enrolled in a Bachelor's or Master's program in Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or Industrial Engineering, or a related field, at a Canadian university, graduating between December 2027 and summer 2028 (required) . Master's students who worked between degrees should have less than 2 years of full-time experience.

• Professional proficiency in French and English , written and spoken (required)

• Hands-on comfort with electromechanical hardware, including disassembly, inspection, and basic electrical troubleshooting with tools like a multimeter

• Strong analytical skills and comfort working with large, imperfect datasets to reach clear conclusions

• Familiarity with structured problem-solving methods (5 Whys, fishbone diagrams, 8D, FMEA)

• Curious and detail-oriented, with clear written communication

• Previous internship or co-op in quality, reliability, test, or failure analysis is a plus

• SQL or Python, and experience with Mode, Hex, Tableau, or Power BI, is a plus

• Familiarity with Jira or similar ticketing tools is a plus

• Exposure to e-bikes, batteries, automotive, or other electromechanical products, or to reading wiring diagrams, is a plus

Benefits:

• Mental health benefits

• In addition to holidays, interns receive 2 days paid time off and 3 days sick time off

• Subsidized commuter benefits and Lyft ride credits

It is live, it runs the operations of two companies, and it grows every week. This is why we are looking for the second person in our permanent engineering duo. Your role You work as one of two engineers on our system, with a focus on the Python backend: data model, business logic, APIs and the integrations our operations run on. If full stack is your thing, the rest is open to you: the staff portal in Next.js and our two apps in React Native. You share responsibility and cover for each other, in everyday work and during vacations. You build features from the data model through the business logic to the finished API endpoint, and all the way to the screen if you want. You work on core topics like the budget engine, billing, the payroll pipeline and matching. Logic where diligence really counts. You maintain code in production that real people use every day: our operations team, caregivers, and customers with their families. title: Data Analyst FlixTrain Operations (m/w/d)
description:
Bei FlixTrain gestaltest du die Zukunft der Mobilität aktiv mit. Wir bieten dir nicht nur sichere Arbeitsplätze sowie attraktive Zusatzleistungen, sondern auch ein dynamisches, internationales Umfeld, in dem deine Ideen echten Einfluss haben.

FlixTrain hat es sich zum Ziel gesetzt, Zugreisen in Deutschland besser, umweltfreundlicher und barrierefreier zu gestalten. Wir wachsen rasant und damit auch unser Anspruch, jede Entscheidung datenbasiert zu treffen. Deshalb bauen wir etwas Neues auf: ein eigenes, zentrales Data-Analytics-Team bei FlixTrain. Du gehörst zu den ersten Mitarbeitern dieses Teams - das bedeutet echte Verantwortung, echten Einfluss und die Chance, unsere Arbeit mit Daten vom ersten Tag an mitzugestalten. Gemeinsam mit einem erfahrenen Analysten entwickeln Sie unsere Standards und arbeiten eng mit unseren operativen Abteilungen zusammen, um operative Daten in Dashboards, Erkenntnisse und Entscheidungen zu übersetzen, die das Unternehmen voranbringen.

Über die Rolle

• Gemeinsam mit unseren Fachbereichen entwickelst du End-to-End-Analytics-Lösungen mit Power BI, Snowflake, Python und Git und schaffst damit die Grundlage für datenbasierte Entscheidungen

• Als Ansprechpartner für den Datenbereich Operations übersetzt du komplexe Fragestellungen in aussagekräftige Analysen, Dashboards und Handlungsempfehlungen und unterstützt in der Aufbauphase des Teams auch weitere Unternehmensbereiche

• Datenpipelines und Reporting-Prozesse entwickelst und automatisierst du kontinuierlich weiter und integrierst externe Datenquellen in unser Data Warehouse

• In enger Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Data- und Engineering-Teams verantwortest du den gesamten Lifecycle deiner Analytics-Lösungen - von der Datenmodellierung über Testing und Visualisierung bis hin zum produktiven Betrieb

• Durch hohe Qualitätsstandards, saubere Dokumentation und verlässliche KPI-Modelle sorgst du dafür, dass unsere Datenprodukte als „Single Source of Truth“ genutzt werden können

Über Dich

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossenes Studium im Bereich Wirtschaftsinformatik, Informatik, Data Science, Mathematik oder Statistik oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation

• Mindestens zwei Jahre Berufserfahrung als Data Analyst, Business Analyst, Analytics Engineer oder in einer vergleichbaren analytischen Rolle

• Sehr gute Kenntnisse in SQL, Python und Git sowie Erfahrung in der Erstellung von Dashboards und Reports mit Power BI

• Analytisches Denkvermögen, ein gutes Verständnis für Business-Zusammenhänge sowie eine strukturierte und eigenverantwortliche Arbeitsweise zeichnen dich aus

• Sehr gute Deutsch - und Englischkenntnisse ( mind. C1-Niveau ) sowie Freude an der Zusammenarbeit mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern

Bei uns zählt der Blick auf das Ganze - auch wenn du nicht alle Anforderungen zu 100 % erfüllst, aber dennoch glaubst, etwas bewegen zu können, freuen wir uns auf deine Bewerbung! 

Was Wir Bieten

• Reisevorteile: 12 kostenlose Flix-Gutscheine + 12 Rabattgutscheine für Freunde & Familie.

• Arbeiten von Überall: Je nach Rolle kannst du bis zu 60 Tage pro Jahr von einem anderen Standort aus arbeiten.

• Hybrides Arbeitsmodell: Wir sind ein Unternehmen mit Bürokultur, bieten jedoch Flexibilität, um Arbeit und Leben in Einklang zu bringen.

• Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangebote: Zugang zu vertraulichen Einzelberatungen, Kursen und Stressbewältigungsmaßnahmen - für dich und bis zu vier Familienangehörige.

• Lernen & Entwicklung: Nutze Sprachkurse, Schulungen und Experten-Sessions, um deine Fähigkeiten auszubauen.

• Mentoring-Programm: Vernetze dich mit erfahrenen Kollegen, um Einblicke zu gewinnen und deine Karriere zu beschleunigen.

Warum Teil von Flix werden?  

Bei Flix konzentrieren wir uns darauf, Reisen einfach, sicher und erschwinglich zu gestalten - sowohl für unsere Passagiere als auch für unsere Mitarbeiter. Hier geht es schnell voran, und es gibt viel Raum, etwas zu bewegen. Wir wachsen und entwickeln uns täglich weiter und suche

title: Customer Support Agent - Dressly
description:
[https://app.ashbyhq.com/api/images/user-content/586ac3cb-f234-40cf-96fd-3daae8c41309/3a2721ac-0cf6-4bb5-a785-483b8d1018c3/Ashby_header.png]

Що варто знати про SKELAR? Це венчур-білдер - іншими словами, компанія, яка будує компанії. З нами фаундери створюють consumer-бізнеси, які стають лідерами на глобальних ринках EdTech, Mental health, Petcare, FashionTech та інших.

Скеларівці будують tech-продукти, які здобувають відзнаки від Product Hunt, The Webby Awards та отримують тисячі позитивних відгуків на TrustPilot. Загалом tech-продуктами наших бізнесів користуються 10+ млн людей у світі.
Усе завдяки сильним командам, бо наші спеціалісти - це ключова цінність SKELAR.

Для професійної реалізації ми створили середовище з експертизою та необмеженими можливостями - і шукаємо тих, хто прагне викликів.

Dressly - це Fashion-tech стартап на етапі активного скейла, що допомагає людям знайти свій стиль, почуватися впевнено й сміливо проявлятись.

Зараз ми розбудовуємо власну in-house підтримку і шукаємо того/ту, хто любить швидкий темп і чує користувача, на позицію Customer Experience Agent. Віримо, що класний досвід починається з турботи про кожного всередині команди.

Що для нас важливо?

- Рівень англійської B1+;
- Готовність працювати в нічні зміни (~6 в місяць). Маємо 30 хвилинний брейк та Slack Huddle для командної взаємодії, щоб залишатися в тонусі;
- Досвід роботи з клієнтами: телефоном, поштою, в чатах та/або наживо;
- Ініціативність та організованість: ми заохочуємо говорити про проблеми та пропонувати шляхи їх вирішення. Вміємо брати на себе відповідальність за досягнення/факапи та контролюємо свій робочий час на зміні;
- Бажання вчитися і розвиватися у сфері IT: більшість лідів команд виросли з Junior позицій.

Перевагою буде досвід роботи з helpdesk платформою (Zendesk або Freshdesk).

Які виклики чекають:
- Бути голосом і обличчям Dressly для користувачів, відповідь на запити клієнтів через email та чати, в майбутньому через телефоні дзвінки.
- Працювати у змінному графіку (включно з нічними змінами) та виконувати KPI;
- Занурюватися у продукт глибше, ніж будь-хто інший: швидко опановувати всі флоу підтримки, знаходити слабкі місця та допомагати робити сервіс ще зручнішим і ефективнішим;

Support в Dressly це:
- Можливість вирости швидко - ми активно масштабуємось;
- Можливість реалізовувати свої ідеї та пропозиції з першого робочого тижня.
- Ремоут та гнучкий графік який можна адаптувати під свій стиль життя.
- Отримувати регулярні performance review, прозорий фідбек і простір для ініціатив.

У SKELAR ми побудували середовище для професійної самореалізації:

- SKELAR Platform. Це операційне ядро венчур-білдера, що допомагає фаундерам швидше проходити шлях від нуля до одиниці. Так команди бізнесів фокусуються на продукті - а 10+ команд в складі Platform закривають функції Legal, Finance, HR, Admin, Talent Acquisition, Employer Branding, IT та інші.

- Нетворк та обмін досвідом як частина культури. Серед наших колег - кофаундери, які запустили не один бізнес, а також найсильніші спеціалісти на ринку. Тож ми маємо доступ до необхідної експертизи на відстані витягнутої руки.

- Ексклюзивна доменна освіта. Ми створили власні навчальні програми для тіммейтів на вибір - від 2-місячної школи для менеджерів-початківців до інтенсивів про AI та професійних клубів з розробки, продакт-менеджменту тощо.

- Вплив на системну допомогу Україні. Маємо благодійний фонд SKELAR foundation, який створили самі скеларівці - і завдяки кожному співробітнику втілюємо важливі соціальні проєкти. Наприклад, заснували перший у Європі акселератор для ветеранів https://veteranventure.skelar.tech/ і формуємо майданчик для підтримки ветеранів на рівні держави.

- Екосистема для продуктивної роботи. Для скеларівців створені простори, які надихають на результат - з власним спортзалом, скеледромом, зеленими зонами Bali та бібліотеками. У спейсах, де сервіс, безпека та комфорт синхронізовані з темпом зростання команд, отримуємо вау-досвід та працюємо ефектив

title: Inventory & Replacement Worker
description:
V Rohlíku je spokojenost zákazníků na prvním místě a náš sklad v Praze 6 - Liboci je srdcem celého provozu. Hledáme kolegu nebo kolegyni na pozici Náhradáře. Nehledáme člověka do kanceláře, ale parťáka přímo do akce v provozu. Budeš to ty, kdo pohlídá, aby byla každá zákaznická objednávka kompletní, a zachrání situaci v momentě, kdy nějaký produkt v regálu chybí.

Proč je tahle role zajímavá

- Budeš mít přímý dopad na spokojenost zákazníků - díky tobě dostanou své nákupy kompletní a včas.

- Staneš se důležitou součástí našeho zavedeného Libockého týmu a ovlivníš každodenní chod provozu.

- Nečeká tě stereotypní práce - budeš v neustálém pohybu a v centru dění moderní logistiky.

- Naučíš se perfektně znát celý náš sortiment i vnitřní logistické procesy.

- Staneš se klíčovou spojkou mezi jednotlivými týmy napříč celým skladem.

Co tě u nás čeká

- Operativní řešení chybějících položek v objednávkách přímo na place a dohled nad jejich kompletností.

- „Detektivní“ práce ve skladu - zjišťování příčin chybějícího zboží a návrhy řešení, aby se chyby neopakovaly.

- Úzká spolupráce s týmy příjmu, kompletace i expedice a podpora pickerům, když si nevědí rady.

- Zpracování vratek - přebírání a správné opětovné naskladňování zboží od kurýrů nebo ze zrušených objednávek.

- Práce na směny v režimu krátký/dlouhý týden (12hodinové směny).

Co od tebe očekáváme

- Schopnost bleskově se rozhodovat a zachovat si chladnou hlavu i v dynamickém provozu.

- Pro-zákaznický přístup - spokojenost zákazníka je pro tebe vždy na prvním místě.

- Skvělé komunikační dovednosti a schopnost jednat s lidmi na rovinu a férově.

- Analytické oko a chuť dívat se pod povrch věcí a hledat souvislosti.

- Ochotu pracovat na směny (12hodinové směny, krátký/dlouhý týden).

Co ti nabídneme

- Rohlík Xtra účet zdarma - nakupování s 10% cashbackem v podobě kreditů na další nákupy.

- Možnost placeného volna - čas na odpočinek a regeneraci.

- Dotované obědy & občerstvení zdarma - dobré jídlo, skvělá káva a čerstvé ovoce přímo na pracovišti každý den.

- Příspěvek na ošatné - 86 Kč navíc ke každé odpracované směně.

- Systém odměn za pochvaly - sbírání hvězdiček od kolegů a jejich výměna za vouchery do Alzy, Notina a dalších e-shopů.

- Multisport karta - příspěvek na sport i zasloužený relax po práci.

- Fajn firemní akce - společné oslavy úspěchů.

title: Employee Benefits Producer
description:
About Keystone
Keystone is one of the largest and fastest-growing insurance brokerages in the country - ranked #26 among U.S. retail brokers and #4 fastest-growing in the Top 50 by Business Insurance. Our platform spans 33+ states, 180+ agency partners, and more than $500 million in revenue - uniting some of the country's most respected independent agencies with the scale, tools, and resources of a national brokerage. Through operational support in finance, HR, marketing, technology, producer development, and M&A, we empower agencies to grow while preserving what makes them who they are - their client relationships and their role in the communities they serve. Guided by our trademarked commitment, "Trust, our most important policy," Keystone is building the insurance solution every family and business can count on. For more information, visit .
Employee Benefits Producer
Position Summary:
The primary function of this role is to drive new business growth and maintain a profitable book of group employee benefits insurance accounts. This role is responsible for identifying new business opportunities, building long-term client relationships, and delivering customized insurance and risk management solutions. The ideal candidate is a consultative sales professional with a passion for helping businesses protect their assets and achieve their goals through strategic insurance planning.
Key Responsibilities:
Business Development & Sales

• Prospect and cultivate new group benefits insurance opportunities through networking, referrals, cold outreach, community involvement, and industry events.

• Develop and execute strategic sales plans in partnership with Sales Leadership to achieve individual and agency growth objectives.

• Conduct comprehensive risk assessments to understand client exposures and recommend tailored insurance solutions.

• Prepare and present professional insurance proposals that clearly communicate coverage options, value, and competitive advantages.

• Maintain an active and organized sales pipeline within the CRM, ensuring timely follow-up and accurate forecasting.

• Collaborate with the marketing team on targeted prospecting campaigns and lead generation initiatives.

• Identify opportunities to cross-sell additional insurance products and coordinate referrals across business lines.

Client Relationship Management

• Serve as a trusted advisor and primary point of contact for group benefits clients throughout the sales process and beyond.

• Develop long-term relationships by delivering exceptional service, proactive communication, and ongoing risk management guidance.

• Conduct regular policy reviews to ensure coverage remains aligned with clients' evolving business needs while identifying opportunities for additional products and services.

• Partner closely with Account Managers to ensure a seamless client experience, promote retention, and support account growth.

Market and Industry Knowledge

• Stay informed on group benefits insurance products, carrier appetites, underwriting guidelines, market trends, and regulatory developments.

• Build and maintain productive relationships with insurance carriers and underwriters to negotiate competitive coverage and pricing.

description:
Before the detail, here's the challenge you'd help us solve.

We build the embodied intelligence that moves real vehicles safely, and the ecosystem a billion machines will run on in the future. Very few people in AI can say this. Every role here, whatever the team, plugs into that.

Here’s what this particular role covers.

🛠️ About our Engineering Teams

Robot Software builds the on-vehicle software platform that Wayve’s AI Driver runs on. Within it, the Experiment Platform team owns the systems that let our researchers develop driving models on the road: deploying models to vehicles, running experiments, and collecting the data that trains the next model.

The team builds a portable development platform that connects to partner vehicles and brings Wayve’s model development capabilities to them, including data collection, experiment control, telemetry and over-the-air updates. It is used across our own fleet and on pre-production vehicles with OEM partners in Europe and Japan, and is central to how Wayve adapts its AI Driver to new vehicles. You will lead a team of engineers based in London, working alongside the Runtime Platform, OS, Sensors and Platform Integration teams in Robot Software.

🧠 Your day-to-day

You will lead the team’s people, plans and partnerships. Most of your time goes to your engineers: regular 1:1s, clear expectations, feedback, performance and promotion cycles, and helping technical leads take on more scope. You will work with your tech leads on technical decisions, own the outcomes, and make sure the team responds well when issues come up in the field. You will maintain the team’s mission, charter and twelve-month roadmap, turn them into quarterly and six-week plans, and keep delivery on track.

You will be the team’s main point of contact for partner engineering teams, programme managers, operations and OEM customers, and you will make it clear what the team owns.

You will stay technically capable and aware of the team’s work across the codebase. You will monitor the architecture, guide the team through technical blockers when needed, and engage with technical leaders in other teams at a technical level.

Growing the platform: Take the development platform from its first stable release to a product used across many vehicle types, with predictable releases and validation in CI and on HIL benches.

Experiment control and fleet orchestration: Own model and controller download, the robot state machine, and over-the-air deployment of software, configuration and calibration.

Self-serve experimentation: Make the platform self-serve, so research teams can run their own experiments on vehicles without waiting for platform changes.

Scaling data collection: Onboard and event-based logging, data quality, and data offload over

New vehicles and OEM integrations: Deploy the full platform on Wayve’s next-generation vehicles, and support new OEM integrations through configuration rather than new releases.

Building the operating model around the platform: Releases, support rota, on-call, metrics and observability.

Building the team: Own hiring and onboarding, and grow the team as adoption of the platform expands.

🙌 You should apply if:

You have managed software engineering teams, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

You have owned a platform or product that other teams or customers relied on, and shipped it to devices in the field.

You are technically capable, with hands-on experience in embedded Linux systems software (C++ or Python), and stay close enough to the code to review your team’s work, guide architecture and help resolve technical blockers.

You understand connected device fleets, such as vehicles, robots or IoT, including data logging and offload, over-the-air updates and observability.

You are comfortable leading delivery across many stakeholders, including external partners, and can engage with other technical leaders as a technical peer.

Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning-courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

title: Coding & Documentation Compliance Specialist (CPC/CPMA)
description:
This is a remote position.
Remote (US-based) · Independent contractor · ~15-20 hrs/week ongoing · Reports to the Senior Medical Director
About Shapely

Shapely is transforming the weight loss industry through an innovative physician-led approach that makes weight loss care affordable for everyone. With evidence-based care, industry-leading support, and a seamless integrated app, we help thousands of patients across California, Florida, New York, and Texas access GLP-1 therapies and comprehensive weight management, all covered by insurance, including Medicare. Most of our patients are over 65.
Our care model is longitudinal and includes MDs/DOs, NPs, PAs, and RDNs. We bill fee-for-service and also participate in MIPS.
The role
You'll be the person who makes sure what we document supports what we bill, and that we're capturing everything we legitimately earn. This is a hands-on coding and auditing role reporting to the Senior Medical Director - not a policy, billing-clerk, or general compliance position.
You'll work in two modes. Prospectively, you'll help us assess which codes are safe to use for a given visit type as well as what documentation needs to be present to use teh coe compliantly. Retrospectively, you'll audit charts to confirm the documentation holds up with high accuracy, and turn opportunities for improvement into templates, workflow fixes, and education.
What you'll do
Audit

• Conduct a baseline documentation audit (10-20 charts per billing provider) across encounters, and deliver a findings report with error rates by provider and service line

• Run ongoing quarterly audits (10 charts per provider) plus focused service-line reviews.

• Perform 100% pre-bill review during new-code rollouts until the error rate is under 5%

• Place any provider above a 10% error rate on monthly review with targeted education until they're back under threshold

Code evaluation

• Evaluate appropriateness of unused or underused codes for our care model and define the documentation each requires before we bill it

• Write documentation guidance for our clinical staff and billing team.

MIPS

• Assist with success with MIPS, including determining appropriate measures and ensuring our documentation exceeds requirements.

• Provide suggestions on enhancing our templates to optimize accuracy and compliance with MIPS

Requirements
Required

• CPC (AAPC) or CCS-P (AHIMA)

• CPMA strongly preferred, or equivalent demonstrated chart-audit experience

• 5+ years coding outpatient E/M, with direct auditing experience

• Strong knowledge of Medicare telehealth rules

• Experience with MIPS reporting and quality-measure documentation

• US-based, with strong Medicare experience

Nice to have

• Obesity medicine, endocrinology, or primary care background

• Prior work with OIG self-disclosure or payer audit response

• Experience building documentation templates or clinician cheat-sheets

description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. ABOUT THE JOB

Anduril’s Demand & Supply Planning team is seeking a world-class Demand & Supply Planner to join our team. The Demand & Supply Planner has an integral role at Anduril, having material flow responsibility throughout the entire value chain, from raw materials to finished goods shipped to customers. They will have full ownership of certain assemblies and product lines, and will be ultimately responsible for sending the correct signals to Purchasing and Manufacturing on what and when to buy or build. This hire will be instrumental in signaling and forecasting accurate demand, planning inventory levels, and ensuring that Anduril supports its hardware requirements via Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP) software and other associated tools.

The right person for this role has demonstrate ownership and experience solving complex operational challenges with creative solutions in a fast-paced, resource-limited environment. • Lead Sales and Operations Planning (S&OP) discussions for Supply Planning on designated product lines.

• Work with Business Development and Growth teams to align forecasts with actual demand plans.

• Develop and maintain processes within MRP systems and associated master data.

• Drive strategic initiatives towards best practices, including demand shaping, advanced modeling, and inventory optimization.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Bachelor’s degree in a technical field (i.e. manufacturing, engineering, analytics, computer science, etc.) or business field (i.e. finance, economics, supply chain management, business administration, marketing, etc.)

• 3+ years of experience in a supply chain or production role within a fast-paced manufacturing environment dealing with complex assemblies.

• Complete ownership of a complex value chain, coordinating between multiple, high volume of departments and teams to ensure on-time deliveries and adherence to quality standards.

• Technical expertise including ability to read technical documentation and understanding hardware manufacturing processes.

• Experience with ERP systems such as Oracle, NetSuite, and CRM systems like Salesforce.

• Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.

• Ability to relocate, if not already local to be onsite in Costa Mesa, CA.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Master’s degree or other higher education.

• Strong experience with SQL databases, including building custom queries for production and inventory metrics.

• Proficiency in data analysis and reporting tools such as Tableau, Power BI, or Qlikview.

• Knowledge of supply chain planning systems like Blue Yonder and best practices in demand planning, inventory management, and S&OP.

title: Co-Op, Materials Science, Heterogeneous Catalysis
description:
Your Impact at LILA

As a Co-Op in Materials Science, Heterogeneous Catalysis, you will join Lila's Materials Science team at our Alewife site to help build and run high-throughput workflows for catalyst synthesis, characterization, and performance testing.

You will work hands-on in the lab: preparing catalyst samples, running reactor tests, and analyzing the resulting data for trends in structure, composition, and catalytic performance. You will work alongside scientists, automation engineers, and data scientists, and you will see how experimental work connects to AI-guided materials discovery.

This is a practical, lab-based co-op suited to a graduate student who wants real ownership of experiments and exposure to automated, data-rich science.

What You'll Be Building

• Synthesize heterogeneous catalysts and prepare samples for performance testing

• Run batch and flow reactor tests, measuring activity, selectivity, and stability

• Characterize materials using techniques such as XRD, BET, TGA, or chemisorption

• Analyze experimental data to identify structure and composition trends

• Support automated and high-throughput synthesis workflows with the engineering team

• Document protocols and results, and present findings to the team

What You'll Need to Succeed

• Currently enrolled in a Masters or PhD program in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field

• Hands-on laboratory experience with materials synthesis or catalyst testing

• Working knowledge of common characterization techniques (XRD, BET, TGA, FTIR, or similar)

• Ability to handle chemicals safely and follow lab safety protocols

• Strong attention to detail in experimental execution and record keeping

• Clear written and verbal communication of experimental results

Bonus Points For

• Experience with batch or flow reactors, or gas sorption measurements

• Exposure to high-throughput experimentation or lab automation platforms

• Data analysis or scripting in Python, R, or MATLAB

• Coursework or research involving zeolites, MOFs, or other porous materials

About LILA

Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves.

LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai.

Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply.

We’re All In

At Enlyte, we combine innovative technology, clinical expertise, and human compassion to help people recover after workplace injuries or auto accidents. We support their journey back to health and wellness through our industry-leading solutions and services. Whether you're supporting a Fortune 500 client or a local business, developing cutting-edge technology, or providing clinical services you'll work alongside dedicated professionals who share your commitment to excellence and make a meaningful impact. Join us in fueling our mission to protect dreams and restore lives, while building your career in an environment that values collaboration, innovation, and personal growth.

Job Description

As a Senior Data Engineer in the Casualty Analytics Group, you will lead the design and buildout of the data infrastructure that powers Enlyte’s analytics and decision-making capabilities. You’ll join a growing engineering team, setting the architectural direction for data pipelines that integrate multiple source systems into our Snowflake data warehouse. This is a foundational role-you’ll define patterns, establish standards, and shape how the team scales.
Key Responsibilities:

• Build and maintain production data pipelines using Snowflake and dbt to integrate and transform critical data from various sources (e.g. SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL, Salesforce)

• Design and establish our core data architecture, defining the patterns and frameworks that production pipelines will follow as the team grows

• Partner with business stakeholders to identify and prioritize high-value data integration opportunities that deliver immediate business impact

• Establish and enforce engineering standards through documentation, design reviews, and code reviews

• Make strategic technology and governance recommendations, implementing frameworks that balance immediate needs with long-term scalability

• Mentor and lead team members as the department grows

• Lead proof-of-concepts and MVPs that demonstrate value and secure buy-in for larger data initiatives

Qualifications

• 6+ years of hands-on experience building data infrastructure and pipelines in production cloud environments

• Expert-level proficiency in SQL, including performance tuning and complex window functions

• Strong working knowledge of Python for data pipeline development and automation

• Deep technical experience with modern data stack technologies including Snowflake, dbt, data ingestion tools (e.g. Snowflake Openflow, Fivetran), orchestration tools (e.g. Dagster, Airflow), AI-assisted development (e.g. Snowflake CoCo, GitHub CoPilot)

• Extensive work with OLTP databases (e.g. PostgreSQL, Oracle, SQL Server), with strong understanding of the differences between OLTP and OLAP systems

• Demonstrated ability to work with AWS cloud services for data workloads (S3, IAM, networking, Lambda, or similar)

• Experience defining and enforcing CI/CD practices for data pipelines (e.g. automated testing, version control workflows, deployment patterns)

• Experience with data modeling (Star Schema, One Big Table, Data Vault, or similar)

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to translate technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and influence technical direction across teams

• Self-directed problem-solver who thrives in ambiguity, builds from the ground up, and influences across organizational boundaries without formal authority

SUMMARY
Supports the Centers for Medicare and Medicaid Services (CMS) Benefits Coordination and Recovery Center (BCRC). The Compliance Auditor performs regular internal audits to research potential process issues, report findings, and make recommendations for improvements to facilitate successful adherence to the compliance requirements Statement of Work (SOW), CMS Internet Only Manual (IOM), and other Medicare MSP Recovery statutes and guidelines.

Chickasaw Nation Industries, Inc. serves as a holding company with multiple subsidiaries engaged in several lines of business (Business Services, Health, Infrastructure and Engineering, Mission Optimization, Technology and Transportation) for the federal government and commercial enterprises. A portion of our profits is used to support Chickasaw citizens. We are proud to support the economic development and long-term viability of the Chickasaw Nation and its people. CNI offers premium benefits eligible on the first day of hire to full time employees; (Medical - Dental - Vision), Company Life Insurance, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, 401(K) Immediate Vesting, Professional Development Assistance, Legal Aid Assistance Program, Family Planning / Fertility Assistance, Personal Time Off, and Observance of Federal Holidays.
As a federal contractor, CNI is a drug-free workplace and adheres to the Federal Controlled Substance Act.
ESSENTIAL REQUIREMENTS
Must be able to obtain and maintain the required customer clearance for access to systems, facilities, equipment and property.

• Operational knowledge and understanding of Medicare policies and procedures.

• Experience working in Medicare Secondary Payer (MSP) related systems.

• Skilled proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite.

• Detail-oriented with exceptional organization, analytical, problem-solving, and critical thinking skills.

• Excellent verbal and written communications skills with solid presentation and reporting skills.

• Auditing experience is required.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES
Essential duties and responsibilities include the following. Other duties may be assigned.
Works with the Prime accepting technical direction and providing analytical feedback. Works closely with the Prime contractor’s Compliance Officer.

Performs annual Risk Assessments and creates the Certification Package for Internal Controls (CPIC) as required by IOM 100-06, Chapter 7, Internal Controls Requirements.

Validates external audits findings, obtains management responses and prepares summary audit reports.

Assists in the development and implementation of annual audit plans using an appropriate risk-based methodology.

Assists the Compliance Officer with investigation of privacy incidents received via the compliance mailbox or anonymously through Navex Global, an independent reporting service.

Assists with coverage of the compliance mailbox during business hours as needed.

Assists in investigating compliance-related complaints and concerns, helping to prevent potential compliance issues from developing. Reports any significant suspected fraudulent activity to the Compliance Officer.

Examines, tests, and analyzes internal controls. Assesses if the BCRC’s system of internal controls and risk management processes are adequate to ensure effectiveness and efficiency of operations, reliability of financial reporting, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations.

Makes recommendations for improvement in internal controls. Monitors significant and unresolved internal control weaknesses in prior audits.
Monitors qualitative and quantitative standards as established to meet contractual obligations and changing business requirements.
EDUCATION / EXPERIENCE
Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent work experience) and at least 4 years’ experience in MSP recovery. A degree in accounting and/or training in Medicare operations is preferred. Auditing experience is required.
